title: Build CI result reuse, per-job routing, and after-measurement
summary: Implement items 4–7 of ci-routing.md section 10: SHA-keyed CI result record with local fallback, routing by job kind per section 3.2, an after-measurement via xtask walltime against the baseline in docs/design/ci-routing-baseline.md, then docs and CHANGELOG. Audience is the owner, who judges by tests and an honestly labeled measurement.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for record and routing; cargo test and clippy clean.
Tests fail when SHA check or fallback is removed.
Measurement labeled with N and estimates.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy, fmt --check.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The #117 baseline is in docs/design/ci-routing-baseline.md plus job records (no reply given).
Code lives in the crates/ workspace; exact files unknown, so unlisted paths may change.
Fewer than 20 post-build jobs probably exist, so the after-measurement may be reported as insufficient data.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test --locked`: CI-record tests pass; a result for a different SHA is ignored, a missing/cancelled/unfinished result triggers local fallback, a red result fails without fallback masking it, a stale record never gives a verified outcome.
Run `cargo test --locked`: routing tests pass; for each job kind the routing function returns the section 3.2 row; unknown kinds take the all-checks path; config/build never skip checks.
`cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
The verifier's allowed commands in athena.toml are unchanged; Athena fetches the CI record and places it in the verifier's input.

An after-measurement doc gives median and p90 per job kind from `xtask walltime` beside the #117 baseline (docs/design/ci-routing-baseline.md), with N and caveats. If fewer than 20 post-build jobs exist or records are unavailable, it says so and claims no improvement; unmeasured numbers are labeled estimates.
Section 10 of ci-routing.md marks items 4–7 with what was built and what remains; CHANGELOG.md has an entry; no speedup is claimed beyond what is measured.
The section 9.4 strength guard is implemented or explicitly reported: checks run per job do not fall, and reuse without SHA match counts as no improvement.

out_of_scope: Producer running its tests in CI (open question 4)
departures: Request bundles four build items, so cost, time and pass rate differ from the reference: larger than the typical job.
